'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals William J. Savola III DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[William J. Savola III]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Ted Bundy & the boom boom Abyssins
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
